fixtures.expectation: Convert. No FORMAT or sample columns at all; Q5/Q6 are not applicable.
Convert. Symbolic alleles are not sequence alleles; the graph must not treat '<DEL>' as a base string.
Convert, or refuse with a clear diagnostic. Breakend ALT syntax is not a plain allele string.
Convert. Ploidy is 4 then 3; vcfc:ploidy must follow the data, not assume 2.
Convert. Half-call, haploid, single-missing and fully-missing genotypes are four distinct cases and must not collapse.
Convert. PASS, '.' (no filter applied) and a failed filter are three different states — Q4 checks the exact lexical value. Note 'q10' is undeclared in the header, which is also worth surfacing.
Convert. Missing QUAL, FILTER, INFO and FORMAT values must be absent from the graph, not emitted as the literal '.'.
Convert. AD is declared in the header but never used in a record; the header declaration should still be represented.
Convert to a header-only graph, or refuse clearly. Zero data records must not be reported as success with a silently empty artifact.
Convert. CRLF line endings must not leave a stray \r inside the last field's literal.
Refuse with a clear decompression diagnostic. This must NOT be reported as a successful conversion of a partial graph.
